description: This Java source file defines the class AIMPaymentServices, which provides methods to perform various online payment transactions with the Authorize.Net AIM (Advanced Integration Method) API. It includes functionalities for authorization, capture, refund, release, and credit transactions, along with internal utilities for building request properties, processing responses, and handling transaction types. The class integrates with OFBiz's service framework and entity model, referencing external configuration properties and external services like HttpClient. It is a key part of the payment processing module in an OFBiz-based accounting application.

classes.name: AIMPaymentServices
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to facilitate various payment operations via the Authorize.Net AIM API, including authorization, capture, refund, release, and credit operations, as well as internal helpers for request preparation and response processing.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs an authorization transaction with the payment gateway using provided context and parameters.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Performs a capture transaction for previously authorized payments.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund transaction; attempts to void the original authorization if refund fails and specific response codes apply.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) an authorized payment before settlement.

methods.name: ccCredit
methods.description: Indicates unsupported operation for credit through this service.

methods.name: ccAuthCapture
methods.description: Performs an authorization followed immediately by a capture (auth-capture) in a single transaction.

methods.name: buildAIMProperties
methods.description: Constructs the Properties object with configuration values needed to communicate with Authorize.Net AIM API.

methods.name: buildMerchantInfo
methods.description: Populates the AIM request map with merchant credentials and configuration settings.

methods.name: buildGatewayResponeConfig
methods.description: Configures response format settings for the AIM request (delimited or not, delimiter character).

methods.name: buildCustomerBillingInfo
methods.description: Adds billing and customer info to the AIM request, utilizing order payment preferences or billing addresses.

methods.name: buildEmailSettings
methods.description: Includes email notification addresses in the AIM request based on parameters.

methods.name: buildInvoiceInfo
methods.description: Sets invoice and description details in the AIM request.

methods.name: buildAuthTransaction
methods.description: Prepares the authorization transaction details including card info and amount.

methods.name: buildCaptureTransaction
methods.description: Prepares a capture transaction request with authorization details, amount, and reference.

methods.name: buildRefundTransaction
methods.description: Prepares a refund transaction request similar to authorization, including reference and amount.

methods.name: buildVoidTransaction
methods.description: Prepares a void transaction request referencing a previous authorization.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Placeholder for transaction request validation; currently always returns success.

methods.name: processAuthTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of an authorization transaction into a results map.

methods.name: processCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a capture transaction into a results map.

methods.name: processRefundTransResult
methods.description: Processes the refund response into a result map, including flags and transaction IDs.

methods.name: processReleaseTransResult
methods.description: Processes the release (void) response into a result map.

methods.name: processAuthCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes combined auth+capture response into a comprehensive results map.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the payment gateway from entity or properties.

methods.name: getCardType
methods.description: Converts internal card type strings into codes understood by the API.

methods.name: getXAmount
methods.description: Extracts the amount from the request map, handling parsing.
